data.gender_notes: Abjad is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: The First Letter of the Alphabet
data.long_meaning: The name Abjad is derived from the Arabic word 'abjad' which means 'the first letter of the alphabet'. In Islamic tradition, the letter 'Ayn' (the seventh letter of the Arabic alphabet) is considered to be the first letter as it is the first letter of the name of Allah (God in Islam) in Arabic. The name Abjad carries the meaning “The First Letter of the Alphabet” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Abjad usually hope their child will grow to embody the first letter of the alphabet and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Abjad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The First Letter of the Alphabet.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abjad total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
